episodes.title: PhD in Entomology
episodes.summary: Dr. Karol Krey, PhD in Entomology, discusses pesticide regulations, the post-approval regulatory process, and how MAHA and RFK Jr. have changed the U.S. pesticide-regulation landscape. The conversation will also cover New York's Birds and Bees Protection Act and its 2027 restrictions on treated seed for some crops.

episodes.title: Cornell entomologist and CCE OC agriculture educator
episodes.summary: Dr. Brian Nault discusses pest-management research in the Black Dirt Region and a family legacy in entomology. Zoe Nafis shares details about Orange County Open House on the Farm, which showcases the local agriculture industry on September 26.

episodes.title: Cornell landscape architect and CCE OC Natural Resources Educator
episodes.summary: Professor Anne Weber discusses Black Dirt Futures, a pop-up exhibition on the Black Dirt Region's history, flooding and water-quality risks, and practical blue-green and living infrastructure for working lands and upland communities. John-Erik Kocho-Schellenberg provides additional Orange County context.

episodes.title: Mushroom grower and CCE OC Horse Farm Improvement Program intern
episodes.summary: Luke Sarrantonio discusses outdoor mushroom farming, foraging education, and functional mushroom products. Harley Wolfanger shares her summer internship with CCE Orange County's Horse Farm Improvement Program.

episodes.title: Assistant Professor of Biology, University of Arkansas at Little Rock
episodes.summary: Black soldier fly farming, insect frass and plant defenses, and translating pest-management research into practical decisions for farmers.

episodes.title: Scholarly Professor of Entomology, Washington State University
episodes.summary: Dr. Rae Olsson discusses science education, forensic entomology, commercial beekeeping education in Spanish, and pollinator-friendly pesticide and habitat management.

episodes.guest: Dr. Pranjal Dwivedi & Dr. Julika von Stackelberg
episodes.title: Cornell researchers and educators
episodes.summary: Dr. Pranjal Dwivedi explains carbon sequestration, carbon farming, carbon credits, and biochar. Dr. Julika von Stackelberg discusses Orange County's climate-related challenges survey and community resilience.

episodes.title: Gardening apps and cover-crop research
episodes.summary: Taylor Truatt Sterling discusses using AI-powered plant-identification apps in the garden. Drs. Sujay Paranjape and Kayleigh Hauri explain how cover-crop legacies can shape corn defenses and insect management.

episodes.title: Assistant Professor of Entomology, Cornell
episodes.summary: Dr. Sara Emery shares Cornell research on apple maggot monitoring, grape sour rot, and onion-thrips management. She also discusses farmer data privacy and the role of on-farm research.

episodes.title: Co-owner, Van Aken Dairy
episodes.summary: Jill Van Aken explores Orange County dairy farming during Dairy Month, from her multigenerational farm family to the life cycle of a dairy cow. The conversation also covers challenges, opportunities, and ways residents can support local dairy farmers.

episodes.title: Farm Hub research and field trials
episodes.summary: Eric Youngerman discusses no-till farming, robotic weeding, and field experiments underway at Farm Hub. He shares how applied research can help farmers and the broader food community.
